_comment: Curated content of the Lingmo Store home and games pages. Ids are AppStream/Flathub ids (case and a .desktop suffix are ignored) or Arch package names. Texts: English plus translations keyed by locale.

text.en: Thousands of games run on Linux with Steam and Proton.
text.pt_BR: Milhares de jogos rodam no Linux com a Steam e o Proton.

text.en: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations compatible with Microsoft Office.
text.pt_BR: Textos, planilhas e apresentações compatíveis com o Microsoft Office.

text.en: OBS Studio captures your screen, camera and games.
text.pt_BR: O OBS Studio grava sua tela, câmera e jogos.

_nativeGames: Native games: open-source PC ports rebuilt from decompilation/recompilation projects. "id" is a Flathub id (source flathub) or "pkg" an Arch package (source archlingmo: shown as coming soon until a repository has it). needsOwnCopy: the game data must come from the user's own copy; never link to ROM sites.
